💻 Zoom Meetings

Bestie meet-ups happen on Zoom. Perla announces each one — date, time, and join link — on the announcement board at the top of this page. No meeting link is posted here until it's announced.

How to join a meet-up

  1. Check the announcement board

    New Zoom meet-ups are posted front and center at the top of this page.

  2. Save the date & time

    Each announcement includes when we're meeting — add it to your calendar right away.

  3. Tap the join link in the announcement

    When it's time, use the Zoom link from that announcement to come in and say hi.

Don't want to miss one?

Email Perla and ask to be told about the next Zoom meet-up — she'll point you to the latest announcement so you have the right date and link.
